line: Introduce two friends who'd get along.
paragraph: Barbara Thompson had just moved into the Oscott Retirement Village in Birmingham when she noticed Fred Jenkins at the gym. They were both eighty-eight, and both had lost long-term partners. They started talking between sets with the barbells. Now they are in love. Neither of them expected this. They are grateful for the company, and for the weights that kept them coming back.

seed.summary: A pair of retirees who both lost their partners have fallen in love again at age 88—after meeting among the barbells at the gym. Now widowed, Barbara Thompson and Fred Jenkins said they’d never expected to find love again after their long-term partners both passed away. Barbara moved into the Oscott Retirement Village in Birmingham
seed.sourceTitle: Retirees Who Lost Spouses Fall in Love Again at 88, After Meeting in the Gym
